text: Entertaining. I leveled up to level 1218 without spending money. However, getting to level 100 is quick. after that there is a pattern. 1.Win 2 to 3 levels. 2.Then you will get stuck for up to 3 days on one level. 3.Magically you will win it easily on the third or fourth day. 4. Go back to step one. If you get the superball thing you might progress 10 levels in one go, but generally it sticks to the pattern.

Don't believe the adverts: this is a standard match-three game almost identical to Candy Crush. The only difference is that very occasionally you get "nightmare" levels (roughly every eight games, I think) where it is like the ad: you have to play fast and strategically before time runs out, as you seek to avert a disaster. These are the games shown in the ads and they're very enjoyable, but they aren't the main game and there aren't enough of them.

Don't be fooled by the adverts; It's just Candy Crush with a different skin. Really nice animations and visual flourishes, but there's nothing new here. The only fun levels are the very rare 'save the king' missions which have unique mechanics, other than that you're just matching 3 like in any other game of this kind. It's fine, but really disappointing if you came in expecting something else.

Like in the other reviews, can't pass levels unless you pay for boosters. Shame really, this game had so much promise. Initially enjoyed playing it but soon got frustrated as not enough moves to complete later levels. If a game stops becoming fun, I delete it. Recently reinstalled to see if anything had changed. Nope, can't pass levels without paying out. If you fail to pass a level first time, your boosters are taken away, making it even harder. Also, on a lot of levels, you are set up to fail.

The advert is misleading. This would be an awesome game if it was just like the advert and you had to solve the puzzles to save the king. But in reality, it's just the same boring game where you have to match 3 items or more to clear the screen. I had to get to level 16 before it gave me a "bonus" level where I had to "save" the king from a dragon (that the king wasn't really in any danger from), by matching 3 items or more to clear the screen. 🙄 Boring, so uninstalled.

As much as this game is fun, especially in the early stages, whatever flim flam the support team offer, it's designed with one primary aim, and that's to make money from you. It's pretty much impossible to win any of the numerous extra challenges unless you're prepared to buy coins and boosters. The Royal League, which you play when you complete all the current levels, is even worse. You have to use coins on almost every level to pass first time and keep your super booster.

Enjoyed this game for the first 100 levels. However, it's completely rigged against the player, so after the early levels, you're forced to spend more and more cash in order to get through the levels. The option to play on is extraordinarily expensive (£1+ per level) and for that you get a measly 5 moves. I kept playing for 400 levels but value for money was so poor that I have now uninstalled. Don't mind spending on games but don't like being taken for a mug. You got greedy and lost a customer.

Full of errors lately, no possibility to report any, not much incentive to keep playing. The puzzles that are advertised are so rare and so basic, not worth it. It is basically a candy crush but more annoying and taking ages to complete a higher level. For example, spent days trying to pass a level and when I finally get the right strikes the game doesn't record the hit and have to start again. very dissapointing.

Wondering if trading standards can do anything. The statement of free to play applies only if you are happy to never progress beyond specific points. The puzzles are buried endless inane filler content. Even the adverts are deceptive, driving you endlessly to the install page, as if that is going to make you install it. All in all a big con wrapped in a massive ad campaign.

Pretty much what a lot of reviewers have mentioned. Once you get past the initial easy levels it becomes nigh on impossible to move on unless you are prepared to part with your hard earned cash. After 2 days and About 50 lives lost I have decided to part company with this app. The game itself is a typical match 3 game with no ads which in itself is great, however, I feel the Devs have outpriced themselves. If the extra ad ons were cheaper they may get a better take up.

Now disappointing. Have played this game for about 2 years and it used to be fun. Some challenging levels but you got through them. Recent updates have shown that the prizes have been reduced for completing missions, card collections, and all the other extra mini-missions you have to do. The game on a whole has become so difficult to pass levels that the only way is to spend money to get power-ups and coins. Used to be a favourite. not anymore.

I have been playing this game for over a year. I do enjoy it as it was not a rip off. Now its just the same as all the other money grabbing games. They have changed the algorithms to make the game much harder than it should be. 9 times out of ten you could clear it buying only 5 extra lives. now its more than 10 moves or more. Using gold each time which you pay for. Hardly any gold and even less boosters are available. Frankly I'm stopping playing now. So your greed has lost you a customer.

I had to edit this review. I gave it 5* after like three levels of playing, but I had to downgrade. There are a few things you should know if you want to enjoy this game. I got this game app when I saw the ad on my sudoku app. The ad was the King's Nightmare. But the King's Nightmare is nothing like the ad. Also, the game is fun & addictive, but some levels are very tricky, & the timing of getting lives back encourage you to spend money to get by some blocks. You can join a team, but too hard.

Game is great, but is set up so you can only go so far and then have to spend huge amounts ov money to progress. I spent £10 a few times and it was gone in minutes. Games should be able to be bought outright for a fair price not this deceitful model of getting you hooked on them, then making you pay obscene amounts to continue on the game

This used to be a terrific game....truly cost and ad free with decent value add-ons if you wanted to make faster progress. But they've increased the difficulty so much recently that it's virtually impossible to make progress without paying. I've completed over 12,000 levels, so I don't think it's because I'm rubbish! No fun now. Don't get into it.

It's a nice game with good graphics. Really enjoyed it until a point where you're basically forced to buy powerups/addons if you want to progress. Otherwise you just have to play the same level over and over again until you beat it. As a free to play user your stinginess has to be greater than the devs greediness, otherwise you'll give the game up after 150-200 levels. I am considering deleting it as the game is just trying to make you spend money.

Okay, so once you get over a certain level, the games become repetitive. I got to level 415....yes I'm that sad....it just goes on and on forever with no end. The higher you level up, the less opportunity you have to get to bonus rounds as they never seem to happen, so no opportunityto get bonus coins. You don't always need bombs etc from the start of a level, but you won't complete a level without them for sure. In app spending becomes a must the more you get addicted. I give up!

I downloaded this game, and enjoyed it for a long time, but once you get to a certain point, it's not possible to win levels without either a) spending your whole life playing, or b) spending loads of money. As many, many other reviewers have said, 900 coins for an additional 5 moves is too much, especially when you only get around 40 maximum when you pass a level, and most of the time, 5 moves is nowhere near enough to win. The new ads for it are completely misleading, and not standard. Avoid.

Not like the ads. The levels shown on the adverts haven't actually appeared in the game. I'm now on level 925 (not a new player) and still haven't seen the advertised levels. The King's nightmare does exist but not the ones they show you to get you to download. The game is a money pit and seems to be designed to make you pay. You can play for free but don't expect to get anywhere - you will be stuck on the same level for weeks if you don't pay!

enjoyed playing this at the start. now it takes days to complete a level unless you spend money (i refuse to do this). Each level should be doable without all the extras or spending. completed thousands of levels, so not because I can not play. dont bother to start playing. You will be disappointed when you realise you can't progress any further without getting your bank card out.

Like most games of this type, fun initially, then it rapidly becomes so hard that you spend days (or lots of money which I won't do) to progress. I wish developers would realise this doesn't endear us to them. It costs to much to be able to play for longer than a few days, then it's just tedious and 5 lives are gone in minutes

Great at the start, then the levels get harder. Ignore levels advertised as hard or superhard. All levels become impossible to finish as the game wants. You're playing a game that wants you to part with your money on a regular basis if you want to proceed. You can buy packs to help you progress, but the game will halt your progress so you need to buy lives to avoid losing free boosters. This will either be really frustrating or cost a lot of money. The developers know this and make millions

Don't bother, it will drain your bank account. Some players get unfair advantage of double points. Not level and you have to pay to get through lots of levels. It was a good game til they changed the algorithm and made it so you cannot get through several levels on the bounce without using all your power ups and paying.Lots of friends have left due to this.

As other have said, what you see advertised is not what you get to play. Essentially, it's just a standard 'match 3', which if you're lucky, you'll occasionally get to see the advertised levels, The normal levels become harder, not because they're hard, because they're actually impossible, until the games decides to suddenly make is easy. As for being asked to buy the extra items to help complete levels... The amount they're asking is total extortion.

Misleading advert for this game. If you want to play like what the adverts show you, don't bother installing this. The adverts lie. Never at any point do you ever have to rescue the king. It's literally just the same as any other match game. After a while it just becomes monotonous, so if you are looking for something different don't bother downloading this

probably one of the most frustrating games I've played, was sailing through the levels and was stuck on the same level for three weeks..... paid 99p to get some more coins, conveniently I cleared that level immediately they've got me now I guess I'll have to buy more gold to move forward. It advertised as free! It's only free if you're happy being stuck on one level starting with 3 moves and 10 billion obstacles to clear. Really frustrating because it's a great time killer 👎👎👎

It was a decent game but at times it now feels like it doesn't want you to progress if you have completed a certain number of levels. I've seen that other players comments have said that the automated aids very often attack areas that you wouldn't want, probably about time it allowed you to select the areas you want to attack rather than randomly firing to poor areas on the puzzle. They have also recently reduced the rewards received for completing levels and quests which is disappointing.

At first I was hooked, but after the first 50 or so levels the game gets ridiculously harder. Boosters are only useful when used with other boosters. Most obstacles need to be hit with a booster 3-5 times to clear. Not enough moves given for most of the levels. An extra 5 moves costs 900 of your hard-won coins. This game is clearly designed to make you spend money. Now uninstalling after being stuck on a level for over a week (40+ attempts). This game is no longer fun, only frustrating.

For one, the game was advertised differently from what i experienced. disappointing! Second, can you not help me solve the puzzles? what is the point of the whole game if you show me after 2 seconds of thinking, what my next move should be! it is very annoying. that option should have a choice of turning on or off, in case it is essential for someone, but for me... it made me uninstall the game 🤬

The game use to be so enjoyable. They have lowered the amount of coins you can win on each level, removed the lava quest and replaced with ancient that you have to clear 3 times the amount of levels to get less coins. It's harder to complete tasks such as cauldrons to win weapons etc. It seems they are just trying to get people to spend money. 5 members of my team have left to no longer play the game. Greed will cost the popularity of the game and they will end up being the losers. Shame🥲

It's a really addictive game, lovely graphics and just enjoyable to play, however, there is always an however, it may be ad free, but some levels are so hard its impossible to pass them without paying for more moves, I mean £1.99 for 1000 coins and 900 of them needed for 5 moves and moving forward it will cost another 1900 coins for another 5 moves, ouch thats expensive and thats why this game has no Ads! I have got into the trap of paying for more moves, I'm sad to say. dont download!

I love this game. But I'm going to moan about the extra life minutes and extra weapons helps we may randomly get for half an hour. I have no choice whether to accept. It says tap the screen, but I have to tap to exit, so I have to accept. Its extremely annoying if I'm about to leave the game because I have to do something else. Let us save for later, or pause the time while we cant play please.

I never ever leave reviews but this one I had to. The adverts show the guy sliding down tubes from room to room and matching things to release water or rocks to clear the way. Then you download it and it's another boring match 3 game - deleted immediately. Other reviews say you can only play the "King's Nightmare" levels every 50 - 100 of normal match levels so it's a complete waste of time. How about actually making the game you're advertising or advertising for the game it actually is?

The game is great. Best of all here without ads. But there are also scams to make money from your purchases. I'm in 1st place on Lightening rush with 20000 points and the 2nd behind me is with 3000 just 5 minutes before the final ... I exit the app and then log back in and see what this 2nd (who is obviously a bot) has done in those 5 minutes 30000 points and I'm in 2nd place at the end and I don't win anything. In 5 minutes there is no way to complete so many levels to earn 30000 points ! :@ :@

so disappointed with the rewards and how it seems more than a coincidence that when I trusted it enough to purchase a deal due to being a new customer, 90% off or £5 off any first bonus bundle or feature etc, all it does is crash, continuously, not only spoiling the whole experience but feeling short changed and stupid for buying in the first place. I'm not sure how or if there is a refund procedure, and I it's not a lot of money for the service but has put me of buying online, xx

The luck in this game is obnoxious. Infuriating when you strategize moves to get disco balls to merge, only for the next drops to merge your setup into a rocket instead. Strategy is a joke in this game. It would at least be bearable if you could have retries freely or helpful tools. But no- The 4 tools are in short supply, you *wait* for lives (I hate games that do this) and you need 900 coins for just 5 extra moves? I'm not sorry, and I don't care that it is ad-less. Genuinely abysmal game.

As common with these type of games the adverts are very different with very very little to do with the actual game. The ads for this game are also agressive with a tiny little "x" in the top corner which you have to press 3 times and very precisely or else get sent to the Play Store when you don't want to! How is that going to give anybody a positive attitude towards the game? It will get you extra visits to the Play Store but guess what? It will get you more 1 star reviews too! You're welcome

Loved this game when I first downloaded. Got lots of rewards, boosters, unlimited lives etc. I'm only a FEW DAYS in and that's all stopped! The levels (everyone of them) become near enough impossible very early and my lives are swallowed within minutes. I'd guess using 25/30 lives per level now. So it gets boring very fast! The price they are charging for a bonus pack is nothing short of daylight robbery! I won't be buying sod all from them, greedy pigs.

I made the mistake of getting a season pass and now the algorithm thinks if I lose enough I'll keep paying to win!Absolute scam! Once you get into the 200s you have to buy upgrades to win otherwise it's near impossible to complete the stages. I've spent 2 days on a single level because I refuse to pay. I've now uninstalled the game, it more frustrating than fun. I'm extremely disappointed.

This app is definitely Pay to Play. It is impossible to play without using all power ups. once all power ups are used then you cannot win a level without paying for extra lives! once you have paid, then they have you... you cannot move to another level until you pay more, then you clear a level quickly. Not content with you buying a monthly pass, you have to pay to progress through each level! This game is not enjoyable any more and is not fair play!

Was really good up until about level 269 then it became impossible to complete the level. After about 7 frustrating days trying to complete a level I gave up and deleted the game. If a level is too hard to complete then people are going to get bored and delete it. I guess if I'd paid huge amounts of ££ for boosters it would be really simple-no thanks.

This is a terrible, highly-addictive, money-grabbing, and rigged-probably game. I have been performing statistical frequentist analysis throughout playing, and it is clear that the makers choose when someone can pass onto the next level, rather than requiring any sort of problem-solving ability. This game is far more biased than alternatives, such as CandyCrush

How frustrating and disappointing!!! Keep seeing your 'Royal Match' ads on other games I play, and its nothing like the actual game whatsoever!!! You claim that you can 'choose your levels'??? Well I have played over 2000 levels, and I've never been given the option to choose a level at all!!! And some of the levels you advertise, ie The Kings Nightmare levels I believe are totally on existant!!! My next action will be to uninstall this, and I strongly advise others to do the same!!!

One word for this game: Boring. You only occasionally ge the King's Nightmare (ie levels which is somewhat resembles the game in the adverts) after playing a version amount of levels of 'Candy Crush with stones instead of candies'. Do you get to just choose to play all the King's Nightmare levels? Nope. Are any of the Candy Crush levels challenging? Nope. Uninstalled already after

Ads kept popping up on this game so I've decided to give it try. Is another matching game just like candy crush. After playing a few levels I've uninstalled the game as the the ads are very misleading to what it actually is. Apart from the matching of 3 aspect you don't actually get to choose the levels or puzzles to solve. Is repetitive and uninteresting after playing for a period of time. I was really hoping the game would be what the advert is showing. Unsurprisingly, no.

As usual, another game that breaks trading standards and is not as advertised. Adverts show games and graphics that don't exist in the game. There is no dropping through tubes or getting logs for a fire or stopping a lever moving. The only element that remotely resembles the adverts is the 'nightmare' rounds, but even then it's just another matching game. The animation in these rounds is pointless because it's against the clock so no time to watch it. False advertising. Infuriating.

Not many bits like the adverts. Simple match 3 game. It's great to start with, but it gets difficult quickly. Some levels are impossible without in-app purchases. Got stuck on level 90 whilst leading the plane race game. Lost everything trying to complete it. Frustrated, I uninstalled the game. Can't recommend it unless you have deep pockets. 👎👎

To begin with, I really enjoyed this game. I kept the butler's gift, finished the balloon rise and even won some of the competitions. The King's Nightmare mini-games were a nice diversion, but they are nothing like the adverts. Over time I found that Royal Match became very stingy with numbers of moves per game because they want you to spend money to keep winning. I refuse to do this. I don't mind harder games, but I haven't the patience to keep trying until I get 'lucky' (actually it's a fix).

A good game up to a point... and that point is when you hit emerald levels. They are impossible to complete with the number of moves you are given. But of course, that is by design, to encourage you to either a) spend money on more moves or b) use your resources, which will quickly deplete, and then spend money. Either way, if you want to get a special frame, or a badge etc, once you hit emerald levels, you won't get anything unless you spend. I pack in playing until the 2 week reset.

Have played in a team for the last 3 yrs, we've all got to know each other and I really enjoyed it. Now though there are so many extra team things, dragon nest, collecting cards and swapping, the "knight " challenge etc that the main game is spoiled, far too much going on to be enjoyable. I've left the team and will maybe play on my own for a while. Plenty of teammates think the same. A lot of us are now in a team on Royal Kingdom, please don't spoil that one by adding too much stuff!

Well it took me a while to collect all the cards to form a set, other players swapped cards and it was exciting at first. Then came the gold cards that you couldn't exchange and it was up to you to play until you won a packs of cards, which I did. I found all but one gold, it took a whole weekend to play through what seemed like endless hard games, paying money and completing tournaments to win cards, I didn't find the gold card I needed at all! It seemed like it was impossible to find!

Again..level after level slows up and becomes impossible to play.Suddenly the algorithm will let you win, and you are in the meaningless holding stage; win some games, and at level 60, will be held up untill you lose all your points etc etc. It used to be ok. No Ads, so happy to go with the fixed levels and annoyances. But now, please!I am happy for some ads.,even a small subscription to play a fair game. But will not be forced into what is a rigged gambling scam. utter con.

Edited review and stars lost. Initially nice little game not too hard not to easy. Sadly the higher level yes you expect higher but not to sit for 2-3 days trying to complete one level. Clearly the game wants you to spend money which I am not prepared to do. The game ends up being tedious and boring. I think the unlimited lives should be saved for you to use when you like not as soon as you get you use. I'd like to use when I have the time not just given and then I miss out.

The algorithm in this game is a joke. The recent release, given I'm on level 5455 makes this game unplayable now. I noticed that less coins are being won, tiles that would normally create a bomb or mirror ball suddenly disappear and dont. If you hold too many coins, you are suddenly losing most levels and having to use coins to continue playing. Definitely pushing you towards using up your coins, giving less and suddenly more promotions to buy additional coins. I feel it has ruined the game

hi I am not happy about this app. I love this game however, I end up spending more than is needed. also can you please give us all the super light ball after 5 levels instead of 10. it's almost impossible to resch once you get about 2000 levels! also we'd all be very grateful if you could reward us with more coins and arrows/specials etc. the levels are very hard as it is.

Thisis an ok game for a while but I hit a brick wall at level 249 at which point the level became impossible to clear without purchasing something. The problem then becomes one where you are forced into making a purchase every once in a while in order to progress. Also, the games are nothing like the ads of course. Every once in a while do you get an opportunity to save King Robert but it's not the theme of the game.

THEY JUST WANT YOUR MONEY. I played for 2 years (because I became addicted) and I spent so much money. Yes, it's a "choice" thing but it has promotions and special offers but BE WARNED ⚠️... it just eats your lives. Oh and one last thing, the game is just a match 3 type of game, not that many "save the king from the whatever" levels... 1 in 100 levels and they are all pretty much the same.

they tempt you in to install by showing really interesting puzzles where you have to release the join king from a trap by completing the puzzle so that you can access and l an escape route but the levels which you start off with are nothing like that. I don't have time or the will to carry on messing around playing through levels and 'building castles' or installing a (stupid) fountain. I just want to play the puzzle Which was shown in the ad to tempt me in.

Hi, I being buying coins to achieve my second Pinguin 🐧 the Ice one with the rest of the prices, I know sounds silly be playing and want to achieve something like this because you need spend time and money. I request help to move the lock 🔐 and buy more coins four days before the season cuts but nothing. is very nice when you find a game like this but the same becomes very disappointing when things like this happen. the best game ever after seven, eight years. thank you

I can't buy coins/power ups in-app since moving to a new country because Google play is still showing the game as registered in my previous country. Now I have run out of coins and power-ups and the game has effectively ended for me. Sad. "Chat with support" in-app isn't working either. FAQs just asks you to read a bunch of stuff which doesn't help at all. Again, sad.

Awful after latest update. This game used to be so much fun that you could happily spend a few hours on. Now the difficulty has been cranked right up and the rewards reduced. The developers have clearly decided to now make this game a cash grab and it's so much worse for it. I used to happily pay each month for the extra bonuses but not any more. Thanks for ruining a previously great game.

i had to uninstall as i played for several days in a row at level 221, and couldn't complete it unless i had special items. i tried like 50 times to complete the level but i was always a few turns short of completing it unless i bought more turns with gold or if i was luckily enough to create items in the level with the normal tiles. this game also has a battlepass which is ridiculous, and even with my team feeding me free lives i couldn't continue progressing unless i forked out money, no ty.

I thought this game would be free and fair to play but they make it very hard to complete levels as you move on and you are compelled to buy coins, which they have a way of making sure you finish up and buy more if you want to progress. Also my game tends to not have some in game updates like the current x2 which was on a timer. Some of my friends have it on either x10 or 5 on the new update but am still stuck on the timer. I have been playing this game for 2yrs now so not sure why. Not fun 😏

I didn't think it matched up to the hype at all. It's essentially a rather dull, pay-to-play game, as beyond the beginner levels, you can't progress without paying a high price for extra coins. Also, you rarely, if ever, get to play the more fun games in the ads. If you want a fun game, DON'T download this one.

This is a great game. Too good though. I became a bit addicted to it & started to pay for coins to get to the next level. I'm totally against in-app purchases because I think it could become a serious addiction & people could easily get in debt. Games are supposed to be fun, not a drain on your income. When I knew I'd spent about £10, I uninstalled the App, as I didn't want my spending & addiction to spiral out of control. Play the game by all means, it's brilliant. But avoid in-app purchases!!!

The one good thing I can say about this game is that it stays true to its marketing and contains 0 ads. The bad things? Everything else. The game doesn't give you enough coins per level to justify spending 900 on only 5 extra moves, the music is too repetitive and gets boring very quickly, and of course, it wouldn't be a proper Match-3 game in 2021 without a stupid life system. How this game has a rating of 4.6 at the time of this review is baffling; it isn't worthy of any more than 2/5★ to me.

As soon as you go over level 1050, it noticeably gets more difficult to conquer. More obstacles, less chance of winning levels. I thought it might've been a game with a bit of skill, and before this point, it was. Now it's looking increasingly like you'll have to buy the add-ons to make it through. Got frustrated, then deactivated it. It was a shame because I was enjoying the game up until then.

Another game that forces you to spend money by making levels impossible to pass without spending. Dont be fooled into thinking this game is free as you could end up spending a lot of money as it is quite addictive. It draws you into spending by getting very close to completing a level and will not let you pass until you part with your money. THIS GAME IS NOT 100% FREE AS IT STATES IN THE DISCRIPTION BELOW!!!

Used to love this game, really addictive, untill it gets you addicted and then it's becomes so difficult it's impossible, unless you spend lots of money... it used to be mindless escapism, now its just tedious... you dont get enough moves to complete a level lowering from 40 to 25. The top players climbing 700 levels, 2.3 levels a minute or 26 seconds a level for 5 hours! Who is it terminator!At least give realistic goals...AI strikes again, put adverts in if you need money that badly :(

It is advertised as clearing levels to help the king get to the next level. BUT it's just like playing Candy Crush, totally boring, now I understand why they advertise it so much, because it doesn't get passed on by word of mouth. And no I don't want to make a pretty castle with pretty hedges and pretty ornaments, I'm not in preschool anymore. I just want to play the game that's advertised.

As many others have said, this game is designed to take your money. The levels have become insanely hard to beat unless you spend money. I refuse to spend any more. It's addictive but has lost it's fun since I reached such a high level. It's just pressure, all the time to cough up more money. You get so close to the goal, then lose unless you spend £1.99 for 5 more moves, but even then, you can lose. It's so easy to click on a button and spend £1.99. They all add up over a few hours. Deleted!!

Starts off as a good waste of time, but as you progress you pass less and less stages and it becomes really slow. Once you get to around the 1000 stage, it hang on one stage for days. Still OK when you have to lose 5 min. But ultimately your not playing a game, the app decides when you pass to the next stage. Also, there isn't thousands of different levels. The bulk of it is repeated levels.

Decent game, gets addictive fast... But... I found that after a few recent updates the levels are starting to become extra difficult and become practically impossible unless you spend cash... Not that I want a game to be super easy, but when you use about 100 lives and still can't complete the level it is obvious the game is pushing sales and it spoils the game for sure Would've been 5 stars but the pushy sales factor is quite frustrating

Very predictable game, not a lot of skill involved as it seems to govern when you can finish a level, I have been playing over a year now and you will find you always need that one more move to finish the level which then costs you money to carry on, sometimes you can do 4 or 5 levels in a row without extras then sometimes you can do 1 level in 2 to 3 days without having to pay for extras, so very frustrating, typical game with money add ons, PREDICTABLE.

Used to love this game. It was fun and the levels were easy. I'm now at level 900 odd and I hate it. Games are supposed to be fun, I don't expect to groan every time a level opens and I see there's NO was of passing it. I'm sick of being stuck on a level for days, and I think I'm going to delete it because it is NOT fun anymore. It's just impossible and frustrating, I'm done.

Here for the match-3? There's plenty of that. Here for no ads? You got it. Here to play the rescue levels? Way less than the ads suggest. Don't get your hopes up. Herefaor a fair experience? A lot of levels are down to pure luck or buying/using coins and power-ups. It's designed to get as much in-app purchased out of you as it can.

Awful. After level 5000 is nearly impossible to beat more that 2 consecutive levels. Don't play. Is awful. I had the space journey task. I have done 3 consecutive levels ( butler gift reach the 3rd price) and guess what: the game said I have only done 2 consecutive levels. Enough. Game deleted and good luck. I was playing this game for more than 2 years. But done. Enough. To complicated
